_sample: Stage 3 — Primitive Generation. Shows how BOS turns ONE Creative Brief primitive requirement into a JSON image-generation request for a third-party provider, then captures the result as a creative_asset row. BOS builds the request and stores the result; the provider generates the pixels. BOS generates nothing itself.
_gates: creative.primitive.generate (api/plugins/creative-factory/capabilities/creative/primitive/generate/). Derived from the approved Creative Brief in sample/creative_concept_artifact_v1.md (Concept 1).

requirement.description: Warm minimal desk setup, no faces, natural light, wide angle

provider_request._routing: Provider + model resolved from Admin → Creative Factory → Image generation. Key injected via brief._channel_credentials. Never hardcoded, never a direct SDK import in the module.
provider_request.prompt: A calm, minimal professional workspace in warm natural light. A half-closed laptop, a plain ceramic coffee mug, and an open notebook with handwriting rest on a warm-grey desk. Off-white background, soft amber light from a side window, shallow depth of field, wide establishing angle. Editorial and understated — real, not staged or glossy. No people, no faces, no text, no logos, no on-screen graphics.
provider_request.negative_prompt: motivational poster aesthetics, stock-photo handshakes, conference room, bold shouted typography, crowds, faces, watermark, logo, text overlay, lorem ipsum

_brand_inputs_applied._source: BRAND.md extracted from Vantage Campaign Brand Kit + injected pre-execution

captured_asset._note: What BOS writes to creative_assets after the provider returns. Binary goes to Drive under the operator-picked root; the row indexes it.

production_cd_validation._note: Production Creative Director auto-validates against BRAND.md craft rules. Passing = approval_status flips to approved. BL never sees individual primitives — only the final Creative Bundle.
